description: HSTS preload check for a domain: current status on the Chromium preload list (hstspreload.org), the official preloadable errors/warnings, and our own live checks of the site's HSTS header (max-age >= 1 year, includeSubDomains, preload, single header) and HTTP->HTTPS same-host redirect, fetched SSRF-safely.
